summary: Your site presents a large installed record, but the contractor register a tender panel checks first shows your registration with no projects at all.
The contractor grade you publish is higher than the grade on that register, so the panel may cap the value you are allowed to bid for.

text.subject: Your contractor record is empty where a tender panel looks first
body: The contractor register that tender panels check before shortlisting carries your registration number with no projects filed against it. Your own site tells a very different story, so the panel has nothing to score.
The grade you publish is not the grade on that register. A panel that reads the lower one can cap the value of work you are allowed to bid for.

Your incorporation details check out independently and your Google rating is strong, which is exactly why these gaps cost you. Anyone looking you up today sees the record and the contradiction side by side.
